practice.foundation[3]: The single ticks on the left sides and vertical half-diagonals assert that those sides equal the half-diagonals. This is impossible: each left side is the hypotenuse of a nondegenerate right triangle containing a vertical half-diagonal. Use different tick families for these two equal-length groups.
